**Paperhue 0.3.0** adds calendar pages, a message board, a photo crop
editor and an English interface to the free Windows app for ULANI e-paper
devices (ULANI 永恆曆).

Each of the device's four pages can now hold a photo, your calendar, your
to-do list or notes you write, chosen with the page's new **Show** menu.

## What's new

### Calendar pages

Three new page kinds, drawn like phone widgets: **Month**, **Week agenda**
and **To-do**. They come from your own calendars' iCal (.ics) addresses,
such as Google Calendar's secret address in iCal format, an Outlook
published calendar or a Nextcloud to-do list. No account, API or sign-in is
involved.

- **Calendar sources…** adds, edits and removes sources. Each address is
  checked once before it is saved.
- **Sync now** updates the pages straight away.
- **Daily schedule…** lets Windows Task Scheduler update them at times you
  choose every day. Scheduled sync is off until you pick at least one time
  and click **Turn on / update**; **Turn off** removes it. The PC must be on
  and signed in to Windows; times missed while it was off or asleep are made
  up when it is back.
- Pages whose content has not changed are skipped, so the panel does not
  redraw for nothing.

A secret calendar address works like a password. Paperhue keeps it in the
Windows Credential Manager and shows only its host name. Events and to-dos
are drawn in memory and never saved on the computer.
[docs/CALENDARS.md](https://github.com/markhhm/ulani-epaper/blob/main/docs/CALENDARS.md)
shows where Google Calendar, Apple iCloud, Outlook and other services keep
the address.

### Message board

Two more page kinds for short notes: **Notes board** (the newest six notes
as coloured sticky notes) and **Big message** (the newest note alone, as
large as it fits). Click **Notes…**, write a note of up to 300 characters,
pick a colour and click **Post and show**. Paperhue sends only the notes
pages and switches the device to the notes page. Posting needs no internet.
The same window lists your notes, so you can delete one or clear them all.
Paperhue keeps the newest 50 notes on the computer.

### Choose which part of a photo to show

With **Fill the screen (crop the rest)**, click **Adjust crop…** under a
photo (or double-click its preview) to move and zoom the part that fills the
screen. Drag the frame, drag a corner, use the mouse wheel or the **Zoom**
slider, or nudge it with the arrow keys; **Reset** goes back to the centred
crop. The crop is kept for the page until you choose another photo or close
the app.

### Grain for photos

A new option above the photo pages, **Grain**, sets how the seven colours
are mixed into finer shades. **Standard** (the default) keeps the most
detail; **Soft**, **Softer** and **Smoothest** give calmer, less grainy
pictures with more visible bands of colour. The previews update as you
choose.

### English or Chinese

The app now speaks English and Traditional Chinese. It starts in your
Windows display language, and the button in the top bar (**中文** or
**English**) switches every text at once, without losing your photos or a
push in progress. Paperhue remembers your choice. The pages drawn on the
device are still in Chinese.

### Big photos

Photos over 50 megapixels are refused with a message asking you to shrink
the photo and choose it again. Every other photo is reduced to fit 4K
(3840 × 2160) when it is opened, which is far more than the 800 × 480
screen shows, so pictures look the same while previews and the crop editor
stay quick.

## Download

Download **Paperhue.exe** below and double-click it. There is nothing to
install.

## Requirements

- Windows 10 or 11 with Bluetooth LE.
- A ULANI 7-colour e-paper device, paired with the PC once (see
  [First-time setup](https://github.com/markhhm/ulani-epaper#first-time-setup)).
- An internet connection only for the calendar pages.

## First run

Paperhue.exe is not code-signed, so Windows may show "Windows protected your
PC" the first time. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

## Upgrading from 0.2.2

- Replace your old Paperhue.exe with the new one. The device stays paired
  with the PC, so there is nothing to set up again.
- Pages now have a **Show** menu. A new install starts with pages 1–3 as
  calendar pages (Month, Week agenda, To-do) and page 4 as a photo page. To
  keep photos on all four pages as before, set pages 1–3 to **Photo**.
  Paperhue remembers the choice.
- Nothing on the device changes until you push photos, sync or post a note,
  so the photos already on it stay until then.
- **Push photos to device** sends only the pages set to Photo; the other
  pages are updated by **Sync now** or **Post and show**.
- Scheduled sync is off until you set it up in **Daily schedule…**.
